NOTE: Never purchase insurance in this company they don't believe customer accident situation so on that way they can't approve claim.

I purchased full insurance for my car Honda jazz in RAHEJA QBE named company. i suffer from one incident that I ride my car on single lane road. When I overtake active bike from right side and suddenly one cow was coming on road right side and car mirror was hit to cow. so I push break and on that time that activa hit rear left side bumper of my car.

i claimed to insurance company but they didn't approve claim of full damage. they was asking me to give only mirror in claim. they didn't understand the situation that activa's accessories hit to rear bumper of left side. i am totally disappointed with this insurance company. i have never suggest to anyone for buy insurance in this company.

featured_reviews.name: aniket kolekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very disappointed with the service of Raheja QBE General Insurance. Every year I pay the insurance premium for my Bolero vehicle hoping that the company will support me in case of an accident. Unfortunately, when I actually needed help, my claim approval was not given.

Despite paying the insurance amount regularly, my claim was rejected without proper support. Insurance is meant to help customers in difficult situations, but in my case the company failed to provide the assistance expected.

This experience has been very frustrating. I hope the company improves its claim handling process and treats customers more fairly in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Himansh Kaushik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience. Worst car insurance company ever. Their surveyors and claim managers are all corrupt here in Agra, UP  especially Surveyor Tarun Raj Sharma, Mahesh and Claims Manager Ankur Saxena. They never approve your insurance and find unnecessary flaws just to reduce their company’s expense, complete their personal targets, create a goodwill in front of their company or any personal grudge they hold with the customers. Their senior managers are also not capable enough to take strict actions timely as they are also corrupt. On 06th Oct 2025, my car was hit both in front and back, and as soon as the process of claim started, their Surveyor Tarun Raj Sharma called me over phone and asked to remove the back damage of car from the application or else he will not approve even the front damage. He was acting like he was making a business deal with me and indirectly asking for bribe for approving the claim. He didn’t approve the valid damages even after providing the videos, photos and CCTV footage of the incident. Their manager Ankur Saxena just follows whatever their Surveyor Tarun Raj Sharma says without verifying anything.
Another thing, they never gave me my Towing/Crane amount of ₹1500/- even after producing the bill of it on the same day of claim and confirmed by the Carne Service agency and Hyundai workshop agency both. When i inquired, their Claims Manager Ankur Saxena gave me a senseless excuse that you have not used the crane/towing facility but driven the car which was not even in a condition to drive as the front part of the car  was completely damaged, I told them that i have given the bill of it, you can inquire from the crane facility provider whether i used the crane service or not, then they negated that and ate that amount as the company had disbursed the amount but they never gave it to me.
This is a complete FRAUD company, do not fell into their trap of having less amount of policy. The company should definitely take serious actions on these corrupt employees and my case should be resolved as i have not been provided any assistance till now.
